title: Toastique Allergen & Dietary Guide
summary: Official Toastique Allergen & Dietary Guide parsed from Shopify allergen-item blocks. The guide includes item descriptions and item-level Contains rows for Dairy, Eggs, Gluten, Peanuts, Sesame, Soy, Seed oils, and Tree nuts. Fish and shellfish are added only when explicitly present in the official item name or description, because the displayed Toastique table does not include those columns.
